decisions.quote: Experimental asset markets provide a controlled approach to studying financialmarkets.Weattempttoreplicate17keyresultsfromfourprominent studies,collectingnewdatafrom166marketswith1,544participants.
decisions.reason: At the record level, both shipped and blind classify this work as a replication study because it collects new experimental market data (166 markets with 1,544 participants) to re-test previously published findings from four target studies (while row 429 itself is removed under original because Hussam, Porter, and Smith 2008 is cited only as background/methodological context for a general stylized fact rather than as a specific tested original).
